tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled in every build, development builds included, with no exceptions for development. This is consistent with the separately recorded decision to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception even for internal services.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
